sentences.shows_mud: The water reached this piece at the peak. Mud does not give the depth; a shallow flow leaves a film too.
sentences.not_shown: Not shown: streets may have been cleared of mud in the five days after the peak. No mud never means the road stayed dry or passable.
sentences.not_observable: Not observable: the image does not show this piece (cloud, roofs, water before the flood or outside the products).

replay_peak_4b.rule: wet when the code is the channel code or its code times 0.05 m is below the stage (plan section 3)
replay_peak_4b.judged_rule: replay_river_fit.flood_evidence: clear on both Sentinel-2 scenes (5 and 15 Sep 2024) and NDVI 0.45 or more on 5 Sep, on the 10 m cell under each 2 m pixel

judged_by_the_river_fit.note: The replay was fitted to the Sentinel-2 mud line on these cells, so agreement here is not independent.

not_judged_by_the_river_fit.note: The replay never saw mud on these cells (most are built-up or road), so agreement here is an independent check.

case_se1_4c.note: Report-only. The season layer is a scenario of everything mapped as water from August to October 2024.

buildings_4d.rule: an outline (every 2 m pixel it touches) with a mud pixel within 4 m; counted by the tambon of its centre, among outlines whose centre the products cover

assumptions: Mud is a 2 m square more than half covered by a fresh deposit of the flood, read from one image; it is not a ground survey.
The counts of the image are put on the scale of Sentinel-2 surface reflectance by one Theil-Sen line per band, fitted on the scene of two days earlier.
Roofs are the Google Open Buildings v3 and Microsoft outlines widened by 1 m; a roof missing from them can read as mud.
limits: One image, about five days after the peak: mud cleared before it is not seen, and no mud never means a place stayed dry.
Report-only. No published class changes and nothing enters a planning score.
Mud on a road says the water reached it; no mud never says a road stayed dry or passable, and mud gives no depth.
The image is five days after the modelled peak: streets cleared of mud in between are silent, not dry.
Road pieces are the edges of the planning context; the closure state beside them is modelled (closure rule v1, central level).
The replay's peak and case SE1 are modelled scenarios; agreement with them is not a check of either where the replay was fitted (judged cells).
